categories.title: Website UX
categories.what: Mean of nine areas: eight scored by three site-reviewer slices, and Content and value scored site-wide (owner, 2026-11-28).

rows: A crew sheet is 3 taps from any page at both widths (Menu or Operations, Crew sheets, job), 1 from the crew index; 89 of 94 crawled pages carry the static header with Crew sheets. Plants, railroads, layout and photos have no jump list; the desktop header has no Crew sheets link.
One h1 per page; nothing scrolls sideways at 375 px (86 pages in headless Chrome); the header fits at 980 px.
Viewport on every page, stubs included; 87 block tap targets under 32 px on 19 pages; the layout map opens at 9% zoom.

Skip link and main#main on 89 of 94 pages; crew sheets readable with JS off; 7 tablists pass arrows, Home and End and the exam deck keys; the roster scroller is labelled. Wiring and tables-file tabs have no tabpanels; crew/industries, tables-file and jmri-additions scrollers are unlabelled.
Layout, roster and history gloss their terms; photos, articles, railroads, crew sheets and exam/play (GCOR) do not; photos shows editor counters.
All 87 crawled pages have their own description; the build cut plans and Publication Standards are off-template; breadcrumb sections disagree.
Pages 10 to 26 KB, about 0.1 s; layout-docs 6.3 MB and ai/clinic 2.3 MB of lazy images; build hero 275 KB not lazy.
0 dead internal links in 264 crawled URLs and 422 crew-slice targets; guide GitHub links resolve; /library/ redirects.

Rechecked after #1398: 8 of 8 corrections live; 0 thin pages; about.json (About) blank without JS; 3 small conflicts left (Route 23 wording, the island-end phrase, the Kosmos start year). Visitor 7, crew 8.5, modeler 8, historian 8.5.

notes: 7.3 was eight areas against the live site at main 5c392d9f. 7.6 (live at 2f3c6cce) re-measured Navigation and Accessibility in all three slices after part 2, added Content and value as a ninth area, and kept the other six from the 7.3 pass of the same day. Over the eight old areas alone it is 7.56.
Weight and speed fell from 8.5 to 8 on the 7.3 pass because it summed live image weight per page and the first did not.
Nothing was checked on a real phone or with a screen reader; contrast was not measured.

scores.label: after #1388: memory to the repo, sweep, FIFO land queue

rows: Root AGENTS.md 64 lines, 916 words (cap 1,000); five folder AGENTS.md hold 1,315 words (680 at b09d1de4; jmri and schematic grew with rules moved from memory); no CLAUDE.md.
12 skills of 201 to 1,500 words, none over the cap; dashboard at 1,500 has no headroom. make land is described in three places; merging.md still offers gh pr merge --auto when alone.
14 files and 3,723 words (38 and 10,857 at the 7.5); every rule moved to the repo file it governs (#1382, #1383); one file over 1,000 words (hosts-and-network); no broken links.
orient --short 16 lines in 3.8 s with 3 stale-line warnings; make orient 41 lines in 6.8 s; overlap down from 25 lines to 1.

make ready, make land and the FIFO queue (#1388) run live: tickets in order, no wait limit, check wait while queued; 109 tests pass. The transition lock remains; each PR still waits for its own check.
19 worktrees (43), 7 agent-a* (29); the sweep removes clean worktrees with nothing unique (#1386). 38 progress files, 17 older than a day, all data-masters-L* kept by the active project page.

notes: Rescored 2026-11-28 02:25 at 27e6f052 by a repo-auditor, after the owner asked to fix Memory 6.5 and Housekeeping 5.5 from the 7.5 card: memory rules moved to the repo and the folder cut; the sweep removes worktrees with nothing beyond origin/main; make land became a FIFO queue.
Held back: memory overlap rests on spot reads of 4 of 14 files; the SessionStart hook and make land-wait were not timed.

Next, in order: archive done lane progress files under an active page (17 data-masters-L*); run the sweep after each make land merge and tighten the hook's gh pr merge match; one make land description, linked from handoff and coordinate; split hosts-and-network in memory.
